newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-GALATASARAY HANDED TURKISH LEAGUE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GALATASARAY HANDED TURKISH LEAGUE TITLE.

text.p: Galatasaray became Turkish league champions on Friday when their Istanbul arch-rivals Fenerbahce were beaten 4-1 by lowly Genclerbirligi.
The result left Galatasaray, who have led the league since October, out of reach with a game in hand.
Defending champions Fenerbahce had needed maximum points from their final two games of the season to have a hope of staying in the race with Galatasaray.
"For the first time in my life I felt ashamed of the football played by Fenerbahce," said Fenerbahce chairman Ali Sen after the defeat by 12th-placed Genclerbirligi.
Fenerbahce slipped to third place, one point behind their other Istanbul rivals Besiktas who beat Antalyaspor 4-0 on Friday.
With two Turkish clubs due to play in the European champions' league next year, final games next Sunday will decide between Fenerbahce and Besiktas for the second place.
